subject: Data Development for GenAI Content Creation
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope all's well! Reaching out because we recently partnered with GenAI
AI/ML teams like Synthesia and Twelve Labs who are working on similar use
cases as Graswald, so thought I'd reach out.

Computer Vision Engineers in the GenAI space are coming to us because:

   - They are frustrated using inadequate tools for handling multimodal
   data (video, image, audio, text) and complex annotations (ex: tagging
   emotions / gestures)
   - They had it with insufficient annotation quality that slowed model
   development (poor tooling, unable to handle relationships between classes,
   inflexible ontologies, etc.)
   - They struggle to curate their training data, find edge case data
   and/or debug their AI models.

Do you face similar issues at Graswald? If so, it might be relevant to have
an initial 15min conversation and see whether our offerings fit your needs.
Pretty wide open in the afternoons next week.

subject: [NAME], hope you're well - team in Lisbon on Tuesday next week
text:
Hi [NAME],

How are things going?

Just wanted to drop you a quick note - my team will be in Lisbon on Monday
and Tuesday, if you or any of your team happen to be around, and are open
to meeting?

I know you're in MK, but realise that you or others from your team may be
there from time to time, given many of your colleagues are in Portugal.

Wishing you all the best,

subject: Woven - data curation solution
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

We've recently onboarded Woven, so thought it may make sense to reach out to see if we can help at Torc Robotics in a similar way.

Woven's Computer Vision team faced challenges with existing data curation solutions (Voxel51 & internal tools), which lacked the speed & scalability required to efficiently search through their training datasets (capping out at ~1m images).

At Encord, we've built a high-performance architecture to support indexing and searching through billions of data items (using embeddings visualisations, quality metric filters & natural language searches), enabling CV teams to avoid bottlenecks in model development.

Open to learning more?

subject: We have an MSA with Fraunhofer | AI annotation, curation & evaluation
text:
Hi [NAME],

I met your team in Milan a while back who mentioned that you were doing
some interesting work around computer vision at Fraunhofer.

For context, we have an MSA in place with Fraunhofer as we work with some
of the AI & Computer Vision teams there on use cases such as robotics and
automated visual inspection. Thought we could take advantage of the
existing legal infrastructure to explore how we might collaborate with your
specific team within Fraunhofer as well.

Could be great to chat and get your feedback on what we've built for some
of the other Fraunhofer teams. Open to catch up this week? My Thursday's
looking pretty open right now.
